items.name: Eswatini Nationals 2026

venue.name: Manzini Public Library
venue.address: Corner Sandlane and Nkose'luhlaza Streets, Manzini, Eswatini

items.information:
First official WCA competition in Eswatini.

The fastest competitor from Eswatini in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Eswatini.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Eswatini nationality can win prizes and honours.

Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Eswatini nationality.

The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks.

items.name: Hasta Et Cune'Open Buchy 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkwOTUwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--78e0536f365e8d6445d8c4430723f8d7bf30e1ff/Affiche_card1.jpg)

L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#76076-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule).  

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#76076-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

**Dual Rounds**
This competition will use Dual Rounds for 3x3 Blindfolded (see [regulation 9v](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9v)). Everyone will be able to compete in both rounds, for up to 10 attempts total across the two.

items.name: Temecula Valley Fall 2026
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TemeculaValleyFall2026#66928-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com):
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkyMTIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b2bc7727f88f838068ec100afe336828b0efb343/logo.png)

items.name: Wainuiomata 2026
items.information:
Wainuiomata 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
